releases.name: v0.33.12
releases.notes:
- Fixed the embedded offline Seeq Default preset so loading it now sets both Idle and Startup to `#d13800` as intended.
- Added Seeq vendor, manufacturer, product, model, firmware and pseudonymous serial identity to HTTP mDNS TXT records and structured device metadata.
- Added Seeq model identity to configuration backups and factory-installer manifests. The configurable mDNS/DHCP hostname continues to provide the network-visible device name without altering or spoofing the hardware MAC address.

releases.name: v0.33.11
releases.notes:
- Updated new-device defaults to 75% brightness, enabled power saving and automatic stable updates, disabled beta updates, selected UTC, and kept Advanced options hidden initially.
- Changed the factory Idle and Startup colours and the built-in Seeq Default preset to `#d13800`; removed the redundant Prusa Orange community preset.
- Fixed colour-preset Load buttons being intercepted by the firmware installer and incorrectly showing a restart confirmation. Preset colours continue to apply live when saved without restarting the controller.

releases.name: v0.33.10
releases.notes:
- Fixed PrusaLink auto-detection accepting an unresolved mDNS address and displaying `0.0.0.0` as the printer host.
- Discovery now rejects unusable IPv4 addresses and falls back to the advertised `.local` hostname while mDNS address resolution is pending.
- Added a second API safeguard preventing an invalid discovery result from populating the Network page.

releases.name: v0.33.9
releases.notes:
- Setup-mode Save now tests the entered SSID and password before storing them, with clear success and failure feedback in the captive portal.
- Keeps the setup AP available briefly after a successful test so mobile captive-portal browsers can display confirmation before the device joins the configured network.
- Failed Wi-Fi tests leave existing saved credentials unchanged and keep setup mode available for correction.

releases.name: v0.33.8
releases.notes:
- Fixed a blank Android captive-portal page by allowing the complete compressed setup UI response to reach the client before its TCP connection closes.
- Simplified the setup Wi-Fi QR payload to the canonical open-network form for Android 16 compatibility and regenerated the PNG and SVG assets.

releases.name: v0.33.7
releases.notes:
- Added a focused captive-portal setup screen that shows only the Wi-Fi network, password, scan control, and Save action while the setup AP is active.
- Improved narrow-screen behavior by allowing inline controls, navigation, buttons, selectors, and color-test rows to wrap without overflowing the viewport.
- Regenerated the setup Wi-Fi QR code with explicit open-network, empty-password, and visible-network fields for improved Android scanner compatibility.
- Added factory-installer hardware profiles for strip type and 6/11/14/23/27 LED counts. A versioned USB-serial handshake stores the profile after flashing, restarts the controller, and can restore resistor-based hardware detection.

releases.name: v0.33.6
releases.notes:
- Added a bounded nearby-network scan on the Network page. Scan replaces the SSID text field with a signal-sorted dropdown, collapses duplicate SSIDs, identifies secured/open networks, and retains manual entry for hidden networks.
- Added wildcard DNS and Android, Apple, and Windows captive-portal probes so joining the setup AP opens `http://192.168.4.1` automatically; DNS and the AP shut down cleanly after station Wi-Fi connects.
- Added verified SVG and 1080×1080 PNG Wi-Fi QR assets for the open `CORE-One-Lightbar` setup network.
- Updated the standalone factory launcher to select beta, stable, or exact private GitHub releases, verify the merged image size and SHA-256 digest, cache it atomically, and fall back safely for offline use without exposing GitHub credentials to the browser.

releases.name: v0.33.5
releases.notes:
- Added private browser and container factory-installation tooling that downloads release firmware when needed while keeping factory provisioning assets out of the public OTA repository.
- Added a self-contained standalone factory-installer bundle with a validated manifest and merged ESP32-C3 image; incomplete bundles now fail with a clear error before serving.
- Made the standalone PowerShell launcher respond promptly to Ctrl+C and reliably release its listening port.
- Kept the yellow Setup AP scanner smooth while captive-portal and web requests are active by rendering it from a preemptive 20 ms task on the single-core ESP32-C3.
- Fixed the five-press diagnostic showcase being hidden by the startup ramp or Setup AP scanner on an unconfigured device; normal AP indication resumes after diagnostics stop.

releases.name: v0.33.4
releases.notes: - Added a physical LED diagnostic gesture: press BOOT five times within two seconds to run the lighting showcase continuously; press BOOT once to stop it. Long-press factory reset remains unchanged.

releases.name: v0.33.3
releases.notes:
- Removed percentage text from test buttons, retaining the animated progress background and click-to-cancel.
- Per-color tests now preview the current picker color, including unsaved edits, without altering saved settings. The override ends on cancellation, timeout or a new test.

releases.name: v0.33.2
releases.notes:
- Added progress-button feedback to both Status and per-color tests: animated fill, elapsed percentage, remaining-time tooltip and click-to-cancel.

- Renamed combined heating/cooling labels to Nozzle & bed heating/cooling.
- Color Reset now uses the last selected preset, remembered in this browser; before a preset is selected it uses saved device colors.
- Added consistent button margins and removed duplicate Status connection diagnostics (still available on Network).

releases.name: v0.33.1
releases.notes:
- Clicking an active colour test cancels it; added per-colour factory Reset controls (saved only on Save) and a single-column colour layout.

- Made colour Test buttons compact and aligned beside their swatches.
- Added Testing... feedback with a right-to-left draining fill, synchronized with the device's remaining test duration.

releases.name: v0.33.0
releases.notes:
- Added connection diagnostics with Wi-Fi strength, IP, last successful poll age, failure count and reason.
- Replaced the independent browser lighting simulation with sampled RGB/RGBW values from the device output, with bounded, non-overlapping requests.
- Added individual 20-second effect tests, including PrusaLink loss, with automatic return to printer status.
- Added portable JSON configuration backup and validated restore. Secrets are omitted by default; sensitive maintenance uses the OTA password or a recent physical BOOT press.
- Delayed OTA image acceptance until 60 seconds of healthy main-loop operation, added crash-loop safe mode and verified previous-slot rollback.
- Extended colour presets with optional unfilled-bar mode/colour while retaining compatibility with existing presets.

releases.name: v0.32.5
releases.notes:
- Added a ten-second BOOT-button factory reset, replacing the three-second reboot gesture. From five seconds, a full red bar drains to empty; early release cancels. Release after completion restarts into setup mode.
- Moved the complete Unfilled progress bar section under Advanced options.

releases.name: v0.32.4
releases.notes:
- Added an unfilled progress-bar selector under Colors: unlit, 6% of the current state colour (default), or a custom colour.
- Applied the setting to printing, heating and cooldown bars and their Status-page simulation. Custom colours still respect global brightness.

releases.name: v0.32.3
releases.notes:
- Combined NTP settings into one comma-separated field supporting up to three servers, preserving existing saved values.
- Added validation for empty entries, malformed hostnames, and excessive server counts.

releases.name: v0.32.2
releases.notes:
- Added primary and optional backup NTP server fields on the Schedule page, with hostname validation and persistent storage.
- Apply NTP server changes on Save without rebooting; NTP remains disabled unless a scheduled feature is enabled.

releases.name: v0.32.1
releases.notes:
- Added a red knight-rider warning after three consecutive failed PrusaLink polls.
- Changed the Setup AP knight-rider indicator from purple to yellow.
- Preserved the optional disconnected-shutoff behavior, which takes precedence once its configured delay expires.

releases.name: v0.32.0
releases.notes:
- Renamed and right-aligned the advanced-options toggle at the top of each page section.
- Moved the PrusaLink poll interval setting from Light strip to Network.
- Replaced the Setup AP indicator with a slow, purple knight-rider animation.

releases.name: v0.31.3
releases.notes: - Stopped presentational clicks, including release-note expansion, from marking the configuration form dirty.

releases.name: v0.31.2
releases.notes: - Prevented the release-note DOM observer from retriggering itself continuously after the first-load population fix.

releases.name: v0.31.1
releases.notes: - Fixed release notes remaining empty on the first Firmware-page load by updating already-rendered note panels after catalogue parsing completes.

releases.name: v0.31.0
releases.notes:
- Replaced paginated GitHub release discovery with one bounded static OTA catalogue request.
- Added GitHub Actions catalogue generation after each public release, including release notes and installable asset IDs.
- Limited the catalogue to 50 releases, bounded note and response sizes, and added catalogue validation tests.

releases.name: v0.30.4
releases.notes:
- Restored native browser time pickers on the Schedule page while retaining the saved 12/24-hour preference.
- Made the synchronized local time tick continuously and periodically correct itself from the ESP32 clock.
- Highlighted time-based brightness, quiet hours, and nighttime shutoff rules while each is active.

releases.name: v0.30.3
releases.notes:
- Changed public OTA staging to retain only the current firmware binary and release-notes file in repository snapshots and generated source archives.
- Preserved historical firmware binaries as assets on their corresponding GitHub release pages.

releases.name: v0.30.2
releases.notes: - Registered the Schedule page as a direct HTTP route so browser refreshes and bookmarked `/schedule` links return the embedded UI instead of a JSON 404.

releases.name: v0.30.1
releases.notes:
- Replaced the technical POSIX timezone field with a worldwide country/capital selector while retaining embedded daylight-saving rules.
- Added a saved 12/24-hour display preference and consistent schedule-time dropdown labels.

releases.name: v0.30.0
releases.notes:
- Added an NTP-backed Schedule page with configurable POSIX timezone and daylight-saving support.
- Added time-based brightness and quiet-hours illumination caps with overnight-range support.
- Added an optional nighttime LED shutoff that overrides other brightness controls.
- Kept NTP disabled unless at least one time-based feature is enabled, and used normal brightness until synchronization succeeds.

releases.name: v0.29.1
releases.notes: - Simplified the introductory text for community colour presets.

releases.name: v0.29.0
releases.notes:
- Added ISO publication timestamps to community preset documents and catalogue entries.
- Added persistent preset sorting by name, newest first, or oldest first in the Colors page.
- Displayed each preset's localized publication date and verified timestamp identity when loading it.
- Migrated existing public presets with deterministic timestamps.

releases.name: v0.28.0
releases.notes:
- Replaced GitHub-account-dependent colour preset submissions with an anonymous, rate-limited Cloudflare Worker API.
- Added a free-text description to community presets and migrated individual preset documents to schema 2 and the catalogue to schema 3.
- Added a stable pseudonymous hardware ID derived from the ESP32 eFuse without publishing its raw identity.
- Highlighted presets submitted by the current lightbar as **Your preset**.
- Added strict Worker-side validation, bounded request sizes, integrity hashes, a D1 submission queue, and a scheduled GitHub catalogue publisher authenticated with short-lived Actions OIDC.

releases.name: v0.27.0
releases.notes:
- Moved Effect priority under Show advanced.
- Replaced the monolithic preset catalogue with a bounded index and one independently loadable file per preset.
- Added 64 KiB index and 4 KiB preset limits, a 200-preset cap, request timeouts, strict client-side schema/range/path/duplicate validation, and SHA-256 integrity verification before applying downloaded colours.
- Serialized preset publication and made each preset/index update an atomic Git commit.
- Pinned the GitHub publishing Action to an immutable commit.

releases.name: v0.26.0
releases.notes:
- Added built-in and community colour presets to the Colors page, including one-click loading of the original Seeq defaults.
- Added GitHub preset submission without storing write credentials on the lightbar.
- Added strict preset schema/name validation, blocked-term checks, and duplicate rejection before automatic catalogue publication.
- Published the live preset catalogue and automatic submission workflow through the public OTA/release repository.

releases.name: v0.25.0
releases.notes:
- Added a three-second BOOT-button long press to restart the controller.
- Preserved the existing short-press action that enables the web UI.

releases.name: v0.24.0
releases.notes:
- Added an optional printer-inactivity power-save mode with configurable delay and reduced illumination level.
- Power saving is limited to IDLE, READY, and FINISHED; printing, thermal activity, Z movement, demo/setup mode, or a disconnected printer resets the timer.
- Documented why a charge-only USB power source cannot identify an XPM52C and the recommended dedicated 24 V sense input for future hardware.

releases.name: v0.23.0
releases.notes:
- Changed GitHub release discovery to fetch and filter bounded five-release pages, avoiding the 68 KB monolithic response buffer that caused `EmptyInput` failures.
- Styled the disabled Save button with an opaque light-gray state instead of dimming it.

releases.name: v0.22.0
releases.notes:
- Switched Arduino CLI, Arduino IDE, PlatformIO, CI, and release builds to the 4 MB Minimal SPIFFS partition scheme.
- Increased each OTA application slot from 1.25 MB to approximately 1.9 MB while retaining dual-slot OTA updates.
- Documented the one-time USB partition-table migration for existing controllers.

releases.name: v0.21.0
releases.notes:
- Fixed the v0.20.0 UI initialization error that prevented the PrusaLink Test button and dirty-state Save behavior from loading.
- Added changelog-derived notes to private and public GitHub releases.
- Limited the firmware list viewport to five collapsed rows while retaining a scrollable history.
- Added expandable release notes to every firmware-version row.

releases.name: v0.20.0
releases.notes:
- Enabled Save only while the form differs from the loaded or last-saved configuration.
- Added hover and pressed styling for buttons and navigation tabs.
- Added an authenticated PrusaLink host/API-key connectivity test with printer-state feedback.

releases.name: v0.19.0
releases.notes:
- Added streamed one-click firmware-install progress, restart feedback, automatic reconnect detection, and UI refresh.
- Hid beta releases and beta-channel selection unless Show advanced is enabled.
- Moved Idle animation into its own advanced category.
- Aligned the firmware version with the title and the page Save action with the navigation bar.

releases.name: v0.18.0
releases.notes:
- Added optional Solid, Breathe, Soft wave, and Subtle sparkle IDLE effects.
- Swapped the PrusaLink host/IP and API-key field positions.
- Added Seeq branding to the web UI title.
- Classified strip type, white-channel contribution, and beta update selection as advanced settings.

releases.name: v0.17.0
releases.notes:
- Moved anonymous OTA discovery and downloads to the public binary-only `prusa-core-one-plus-lightbar-releases` repository.
- Added dual release publication for the transition to a private source repository.

releases.name: v0.16.0
releases.notes:
- Added a browser-persisted Show advanced toggle across the web UI.
- Hid low-frequency technical controls by default, including radio tuning, mDNS, OTA credentials/manual upload, web-UI lockout, polling, and separately-powered disconnect behavior.

releases.name: v0.15.1
releases.notes: - Replaced the separate strip auto-detection checkbox with a mutually exclusive Auto-detect option in the strip-type dropdown.

releases.name: v0.15.0
releases.notes:
- Made the detected LED count a read-only text value on the Light strip page.
- Added hardware count-ID profiles for 14-LED (72 LEDs/m) and 23-LED (120 LEDs/m) assemblies.
- Grouped hardware auto-detection with the manual strip fallback control.
- Disabled white-channel contribution unless the effective strip is SK6812 RGBW or RGBWW.

releases.name: v0.14.2
releases.notes:
- Fixed open hardware-ID inputs being misread after ADC mode disabled the internal pull-up.
- Open legacy harnesses are now resolved digitally before resistor-divider ADC measurement, reliably selecting WS2812B with 27 LEDs.

releases.name: v0.14.1
releases.notes:
- Enabled internal pull-ups on both hardware-ID ADC inputs so an open legacy harness deterministically selects WS2812B with 27 LEDs.
- Retained external 10 kÎ© pull-ups as the recommended production implementation.

releases.name: v0.14.0
releases.notes:
- Added boot-time resistor identification for WS2812B, SK6812 RGBW/RGBWW, and APA102/SK9822 strips.
- Added a compact clocked APA102/SK9822 renderer using GPIO4 data and GPIO5 clock.
- Added automatic detection with a saved manual override and ID-voltage diagnostics in the web UI.
- Added independent resistor detection for the three supported assemblies: 6 LEDs at 30 LEDs/m, 11 LEDs at 60 LEDs/m, and 27 LEDs at 144 LEDs/m.

releases.name: v0.13.0
releases.notes:
- Added selectable WS2812B RGB, SK6812 RGBW, and SK6812 RGBWW strip presets.
- Added configurable extraction of the common RGB component into the SK6812 white channel.
- Kept WS2812B RGB as the default and required a power cycle only when the pixel format changes.

releases.name: v0.12.0
releases.notes:
- Made the startup fade color independently configurable, retaining Prusa orange as the default.
- Added stable and beta automatic-update channels; beta is the default for new installations.
- Labeled prerelease and stable builds in the Firmware page.
- Changed tagged GitHub builds to publish as prereleases until explicitly promoted to stable quality.
